PREACHER.desc: Dr. Beelzebub Crow, playa evangelist and flag-bearer. Fervent Chick-tract witness; tells the whole flashback in V.O.

SUMMER.desc: The skeptic: sunny blonde hippie with pigtails. Cheerfully confesses her own sins; converts.

RAVEN.desc: Summer's friend: glossy black hair, hoop earrings, bone-dry disdain.

FLAGMAKER.desc: The Flag Maker. Robed, radiant, patient; carries the DIY flag tools.

DEVIL.desc: The Chick-tract Devil. Tries to call the Flags a game and physically cannot.

FORECAST.desc: AM-radio weather announcer on a boombox in the mud.

RANGER.desc: A Ranger on the handheld radio, looking for his dirt.

DISCLAIMER.desc: Pharmaceutical-ad legal voice reading the footnote at speed.

PHARISEES.desc: Hooded elders in rain ponchos (thickened into a mob by the Vocalist).

HIPPIE1.desc: A muddy hippie who finds a Flag.

HIPPIE2.desc: A muddy hippie who moves it.

lines.speaker: RAVEN
lines.text: Ugh, there goes another one of those YELLOW FLAGS.
lines.say: [Ugh](/ˈʌɡ/). There goes another one of those yellow flags.

lines.speaker: SUMMER
lines.text: I hate that FLAG GAME because I am a LAZY and ENTITLED HIPPY
lines.say: I hate that flag game, because I am a lazy and entitled hippie!

lines.speaker: SUMMER
lines.text: It just doesn't FIT IN with how I think a Burn works
lines.say: It just doesn't fit in with how I think a burn works.

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: Amazing, every word of what you just said...
lines.say: Amazing. Every word of what you just said...

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: ...WAS WRONG!!
lines.say: was wrong!

lines.speaker: SUMMER
lines.text: WHAT? HOW CAN THIS BE???
lines.say: What? How can this be?

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: For ONE THING, the FLAGS are not a GAME.
lines.say: For one thing, the flags are not a game.

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: The FLAGS are THE LIVING ESSENCE OF THE BURN ITSELF!!!
lines.say: The flags are the living essence of the burn itself!

lines.speaker: DISCLAIMER
lines.text: Survey FLAGS is strictly an interactive art installation
lines.say: [Survey](/sˈɜɹvˌA/) flags is strictly an interactive art installation.

lines.speaker: SUMMER
lines.text: Huh? What you are saying is... its so weird....
lines.say: Huh? What you are saying is... it's so weird...

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: Here, why don't I tell you the story FROM THE BEGINNING
lines.say: Here. Why don't I tell you the story... from the beginning.

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: It all started back at Alchemy IX...
lines.say: It all started back at Alchemy Nine...

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: In the beginning there were 6 FLAGS, and each was a mix of Red, Blue and Yellow.
lines.say: In the beginning there were six flags, and each was a mix of red, blue and yellow.

lines.speaker: SUMMER
lines.text: They look yellow to me.

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: Red and Blue are merely the ABSENCE of Yellow. II VEXILLIANS 5
lines.say: Red and blue are merely the absence of yellow. Second [Vexillians](/vɛksˈɪliənz/), five.

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: That year, the terrible STENCH of the hippies caused a great hurricane to decend on the burn.
lines.say: That year, the terrible stench of the hippies caused a great hurricane to descend on the burn.

lines.speaker: FORECAST
lines.text: ...and the forcast for Alchemy: RAIN. ALL. WEEKEND.
lines.say: ...and the forecast for Alchemy? Rain. All. Weekend.

lines.speaker: RANGER
lines.text: Hey, over, uhmmm... does anyone know where my dirt went?
lines.say: Hey, over. Um... does anyone know where my dirt went?

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: The FLAG MAKER walked amongst them...
lines.say: The flag maker walked amongst them...

lines.speaker: FLAGMAKER
lines.text: By FINDING and MOVING the FLAGS, the rain can be stopped.
lines.say: By finding, and moving the flags... the rain can be stopped.

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: Most people rejected His message.

lines.speaker: PHARISEES
lines.text: Shut up!

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: They hated FLAGS because He told them the truth. FLAGS 4:20
lines.say: They hated flags, because he told them the truth. Flags, four twenty.

lines.speaker: FLAGMAKER
lines.text: Each FLAG is a symbol that signifies its own referent. Therefore sign and signifier become are made one in the FLAGS.
lines.say: Each flag is a symbol that signifies its own referent. Therefore sign and signifier become are made one in the flags.

lines.speaker: FLAGMAKER
lines.text: Each FLAG is itself a FLAG... and each FLAG is every FLAG.
lines.say: Each flag is itself a flag... and each flag is every flag.

lines.speaker: DEVIL
lines.text: Listen, my children. The Flags are nothing but a... a... a...
lines.say: Listen, my children. The flags are nothing but a... a... a...

lines.speaker: DEVIL
lines.text: FLAGS! FLAGS FLAGS FLAGS!
lines.say: Flags! Flags, flags, flags!

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: BUT THERE WERE SOME THAT LISTENED...
lines.say: But there were some... that listened.

lines.speaker: HIPPIE1
lines.text: Found one!

lines.speaker: HIPPIE2
lines.text: Move it! MOVE IT!
lines.say: Move it! Move it!

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: AND IT WORKED.
lines.say: And it worked.

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: Saturday afternoon the ALL YELLOW FLAG was placed on top of the effigy...
lines.say: Saturday afternoon, the all yellow flag was placed on top of the effigy...

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: ...and the rain stopped entirely.
lines.say: and the rain stopped. Entirely.

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: The FLAG was still there in the evening, when the effigy was burned FOR ALL TO SEE
lines.say: The flag was still there in the evening, when the effigy was burned... for all to see.

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: But the very second the FLAMES reached the FLAG, a miracle happened.
lines.say: But the very second the flames reached the flag... a miracle happened.

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: Without the YELLOW FLAG to hold it back, the FIRMAMENT OPENED
lines.say: Without the yellow flag to hold it back... the firmament opened...

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: and THE RAIN RETURNED.
lines.say: and the rain returned!

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: HOWEVER, the YELLOW FLAG would be RAISED AGAIN... 50, then 100 time!
lines.say: However! The yellow flag would be raised again... fifty, then one-hundred time!

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: The Spirit of the FLAGS would follow the Burn as it changed location
lines.say: The spirit of the flags would follow the burn, as it changed location.

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: Through a Burn without any fire And the years without any Burns
lines.say: Through a burn without any fire... and the years without any burns.

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: So never forget, FLAGS are the HEART and SOUL of the Burn itself,
lines.say: So never forget. Flags are the heart and soul of the burn itself...

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: and speaking against them is BLASPHEME.
lines.say: and speaking against them is... blaspheme!

lines.speaker: SUMMER
lines.text: What must I do?

lines.speaker: PREACHER
lines.text: Repeat after me.
